description: Lists inbound-request leads from phone calls, website forms, texts, and other sources, newest first, and returns from, to, count, truncated, and items. Each item has id, at (ISO time), source ('call' for phone calls, otherwise the channel), name, phone, service, city, and status. Use it for questions such as how many leads there are and where they came from; use neuron_calls for call duration, outcome, and reason, and neuron_jobs for CRM work orders. It looks BACKWARD at when the lead came in, defaults to the last 7 days ending now, permits a window of at most 90 days, and returns at most 500 leads; truncated is true when the cap was reached. Test and synthetic records are excluded; this Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only, reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:leads on the consent screen, and returns JSON objects also as text. The limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.

from.description: Start of the window: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: 7 days before to; the window is at most 90 days.

to.description: End of the window: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Default: now.

name: neuron_leads

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List leads
